# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| `IterativeTDDRunner` | `src.agents.iterative_tdd_runner` | Orchestrates the RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| `TDDCycleRunner` | `src.agents.tdd_cycle_runner` | Executes a single TDD cycle with GREEN retries and learning loop |
| `IncrementalPlanner` | `src.agents.incremental_planner` | Determines the next test increment via LLM analysis |
| `PythonLanguagePod` | `src.agents.python_language_pod` | Language-specific implementation of RED/GREEN/REFACTOR phases |
| `WorkerAgent` | `src.agents.worker_agent` | Generates test, implementation, and refactor code via LLM |
| `PodmanOrchestrator` | `src.agents.podman_orchestrator` | Stateless sidecar execution layer with hash verification |
| `PodmanRunner` | `src.agents.podman_runner` | Rootless Podman container lifecycle and file pulse |
| `PlaybookManager` | `src.playbook.manager` | Core playbook CRUD, delta updates, redundancy checking |
| `BulletRetriever` | `src.playbook.retrieval` | Hybrid retrieval of relevant playbook bullets |
| `Reflector` | `src.core.reflector.module` | Analyzes task outcomes and extracts root causes |
| `Curator` | `src.core.curator.module` | Synthesizes insights into playbook delta bullets |
| `Generator` | `src.core.generator.module` | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation |
| `LLMClient` | `src.utils.llm_client` | Unified interface to multiple LLM providers |
| `ExperimentLogger` | `src.storage.experiment_logger` | Logs TDD cycles and experiments to database |
| `AuditClient` | `src.audit.client` | Write-only audit client for hash-chained event logging |
| `LocalAuditClient` | `src.audit.local_client` | SQLite-backed audit client for development |
| `AuditStore` | `src.audit.store` | Append-only audit event store with hash chain integrity |
| `InstitutionalKnowledgeService` | `src.retrieval.service` | Central knowledge retrieval for code generation |
| `ContextGraphRetriever` | `src.retrieval.cgr3_retriever` | CGR³ context-aware bullet retrieval and ranking |
| `PlaybookReliabilityAnalyzer` | `src.reliability.playbook_analyzer` | Correlates bullet retrieval with first-pass GREEN success |
| `AdaptiveBroker` | `src.broker.adaptive_broker` | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| `PerformanceAggregator` | `src.broker.performance_aggregator` | Extracts agent metrics from audit trail |
| `EnsembleLearner` | `src.ensemble.learner` | Orchestrates multi-model learning and voting |
| `CapabilityRegistry` | `src.broker.capability_registry` | Anonymous agent capability tracking |
| `ProjectBuilder` | `src.cli.project_builder` | Drives ModuleArchitect + ModuleTDDBuilder over a project plan |
| `ModuleArchitect` | `src.contracts.module_architect` | Generates module-level contracts for stateful systems |
| `ProjectArchitect` | `src.contracts.project_architect` | Decomposes project spec into module DAG |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Plnr as Plnr<br>(IncrementalPlanner)
    participant IRunner as IRunner<br>(IterativeTDDRunner)
    participant CRunner as CRunner<br>(TDDCycleRunner)
    participant Pod as Pod<br>(PythonLanguagePod)
    participant Worker as Worker<br>(WorkerAgent)
    participant LLM as LLM<br>(LLMClient)
    participant Sandbox as Sandbox<br>(PodmanOrchestrator)
    participant Playbook as Playbook<br>(PlaybookManager)
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator
    participant Audit as Audit<br>(AuditClient)
    participant ExpLog as ExpLog<br>(ExperimentLogger)

    User->>IRunner: run feature
    activate IRunner
    Note over IRunner: loop max_iterations
    loop each cycle
        IRunner->>Plnr: next_increment()
        activate Plnr
        Plnr-->>IRunner: TestIncrement
        deactivate Plnr
        IRunner->>CRunner: run(spec)
        activate CRunner
        CRunner->>Pod: run_red()
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test()
        activate Worker
        Worker->>LLM: generate prompt
        activate LLM
        LLM-->>Worker: test code
        deactivate LLM
        Worker-->>Pod: test code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>Sandbox: pulse(test files)
        activate Sandbox
        Sandbox-->>Pod: PhaseResult(passed=False)
        deactivate Sandbox
        Pod-->>CRunner: PhaseResult
        deactivate Pod
        Note over CRunner,Audit: GREEN retries
        CRunner->>Pod: run_green()
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation()
        activate Worker
        Worker->>LLM: generate prompt with bullets
        activate LLM
        LLM-->>Worker: impl code
        deactivate LLM
        Worker-->>Pod: impl code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>Sandbox: pulse(test + impl files)
        activate Sandbox
        Sandbox-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Sandbox
        Pod-->>CRunner: PhaseResult
        deactivate Pod
        alt GREEN passed
            CRunner->>Pod: run_refactor()
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_refactor()
            activate Worker
            Worker->>LLM: generate
            activate LLM
            LLM-->>Worker: refactored code
            deactivate LLM
            Worker-->>Pod: code
            deactivate Worker
            Pod->>Sandbox: pulse(test + refactored)
            activate Sandbox
            Sandbox-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            deactivate Sandbox
            Pod-->>CRunner: PhaseResult
            deactivate Pod
            alt Refactor passed
                Note over CRunner: cycle successful
            else Refactor failed
                Note over CRunner: cycle failed but GREEN retained
            end
            Note over CRunner,Curator: Learning loop
            CRunner->>Reflector: reflect(task,output,feedback)
            activate Reflector
            Reflector->>LLM: analyze outcome
            activate LLM
            LLM-->>Reflector: analysis
            deactivate LLM
            Reflector-->>CRunner: ReflectorOutput
            deactivate Reflector
            CRunner->>Curator: curate(reflector_output)
            activate Curator
            Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta(bullets)
            activate Playbook
            Playbook-->>Curator: added IDs
            deactivate Playbook
            Curator-->>CRunner: CuratorOutput
            deactivate Curator
        else GREEN failed after retries
            Note over CRunner: stagnant detection
            opt stagnant
                CRunner->>Reflector: reflect(failed)
                activate Reflector
                Reflector->>LLM: analyze failure
                activate LLM
                LLM-->>Reflector: analysis
                deactivate LLM
                Reflector-->>CRunner: ReflectorOutput
                deactivate Reflector
                CRunner->>Curator: curate()
                activate Curator
                Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta()
                activate Playbook
                Playbook-->>Curator: added IDs
                deactivate Playbook
                Curator-->>CRunner: CuratorOutput
                deactivate Curator
            end
        end
        CRunner->>Audit: emit CYCLE_COMPLETED
        activate Audit
        Audit-->>CRunner: ok
        deactivate Audit
        CRunner->>ExpLog: log_tdd_cycle()
        activate ExpLog
        ExpLog-->>CRunner: ok
        deactivate ExpLog
        CRunner-->>IRunner: CycleResult
        deactivate CRunner
        Note over IRunner: break if planner says COMPLETE
    end
    IRunner-->>User: IterativeResult
    deactivate IRunner
```
